description: Source code for handling file checkout, directory creation/removal, and file reading in a Git-like version control system.

methods.name: create_directories
methods.description: Creates directories along a given path, handling existing symlinks and directories.

methods.name: create_file
methods.description: Creates a new file with specified mode.

methods.name: read_blob_entry
methods.description: Reads a blob object from the repository given a cache entry.

methods.name: open_output_fd
methods.description: Opens a file descriptor for output, handling temp files and symlinks.

methods.name: fstat_checkout_output
methods.description: Performs fstat on a file descriptor if conditions are met.

methods.name: streaming_write_entry
methods.description: Streams a blob object to a file descriptor with optional filtering.

methods.name: enable_delayed_checkout
methods.description: Enables delayed checkout mode in the checkout state.

methods.name: remove_available_paths
methods.description: Removes available paths from a list based on another list.

methods.name: string_is_not_null
methods.description: Checks if a string list item is not null.

methods.name: finish_delayed_checkout
methods.description: Completes delayed checkout, processing all delayed paths and filters.

methods.name: update_ce_after_write
methods.description: Updates cache entry metadata after writing to disk.

methods.name: write_entry
methods.description: Writes a cache entry to disk, handling different file types and modes.

methods.name: check_path
methods.description: Checks a path with lstat, avoiding symlinks after a certain skip length.

methods.name: mark_colliding_entries
methods.description: Marks cache entries that collide in name or stat data.

methods.name: checkout_entry_ca
methods.description: Checks out a cache entry to a specified path or in-place, handling conflicts and submodules.

methods.name: unlink_entry
methods.description: Unlinks or moves a cache entry's file or submodule.

methods.name: remove_or_warn
methods.description: Removes a file or directory, warning if necessary.
